metadata.change_reason: Reconcile legacy KGEN/merit compensation with the Human-directed KAIOS prepaid living salary model and preserve separate compensation categories.
metadata.legal_notice: Internal ledger and policy only. No salary payment, transfer, signing, treasury movement or guaranteed token value is authorized by this file.

category_rules.SALARY_INCOME: Fixed prepaid living salary for a payroll-eligible employee; payable unit KAIOS; amount requires approved salary table.
category_rules.TASK_COMPENSATION: Reviewed WorkOrder compensation; never base salary.
category_rules.CREATOR_ROYALTY: Evidence-based product/game royalty under an approved revenue-sharing policy.
category_rules.FREIGHT_REVENUE: Delivery, transport or service income; never cargo principal.
category_rules.HEARTBEAT_REWARD: Life-system reward; never salary or company customer revenue.
category_rules.CARGO_PRINCIPAL: Restricted/custodial cargo value; never revenue, profit or salary.

legacy_rule: Legacy entries remain historical ledger evidence. They are not converted to KAIOS salary, paid status or payroll entitlement without an explicit reviewed migration record.
incident_rule: Any unexplained missing payroll record is a P1 PAYROLL_INCIDENT; do not silently delete or rewrite it.
master_flow: Independent Review Or Authorized Payroll Audit
bank_8888_role: Prototype internal employee salary ledger and claim queue; ledger balance is not proof of real KAIOS custody or transfer.
